newMessages.content: You previously settled on Andante con moto at quarter = 72 for the second movement.

I've changed my mind. After hearing the rehearsal playback, 72 feels too slow for the woodwind figurations. I'm moving it up to quarter = 80 and changing the character marking to Andante grazioso. The movement's identity is the same — it's still the lyrical interlude — but the pacing needs to be lighter.
